Short title and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT OF LAWS) ORDINANCE, 2001
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT OF LAWS)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend various provincial laws as a
result of devolution of powers to District Government.
[Gazette of N.‑W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 27th August, 2001]
No. 1egis: 1(4)/95/4325‑30/4396,
dated 27‑8‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province (Amendment of Laws) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into forc eat
once.
